body:
Hi @ledbetterljoshua

The `searchParameters` prop is now deprecated. You can use the `Configure` widget to apply any `searchParameters`. See: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/guide/Search\_parameters.html

Then, you can use the `filters` search parameter which as an easier syntax than `facetFilters`.
See: https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-client/javascript/parameters/filters/

It would mean having something like this:

```
<Configure
         filters="publishDate <= timestamp"
         hitsPerPage = {3}
/>
```
